name: gModelVariant139_aImages
evidence: matching model_variant/variant139_entry.c: ModelVariant139_HandleRequest packs the texture page/CLUT word of &gModelVariant139_aImages[i] for i = 0..1 with ModelTexture_PackPageClutCopy (third parameter GsIMAGE *, blend_mode 1) into work->texture[0..1]; in this image's linked bytes the table holds two 0x1C-byte GsIMAGE records (pmode 9 and 8).
notes: Former gModelVariant139_D1ACC (offset-only name, previously an unsized GsIMAGE[]); same address and linker size 0x38, now declared GsIMAGE[2]. blend_mode is the two-bit ABR selector at texture-page bits 5..6 (notes/model-texture-wrappers.md).

name: gModelVariant139_aBeamImages
evidence: matching model_variant/variant139_entry.c: ModelVariant139_HandleRequest packs the first record with ModelTexture_PackPageClutCopy blend_mode 2 into work->texture[2], which is the tpage/CLUT of the semi-transparent beam quad (config->beam_size corners, config->beam_color fade); that quad's UVs (u = j / 2 * 64, v 128..191) span the VRAM columns of records [0] and [1]. name: ModelVariant139_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant139_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two textured tubes swirl around a centre sliding towards the other slot, a column of beam sprites trails behind each swirl and 96 rising sparks burst into rings of dots); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the tubes, beams and sparks, packs three texture words and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the sparks, 4 while they are released, 1 once after the last, 0 until the last spark has burst and then 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-156 and 286 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and bind its data names 0x18 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
